title: Violin players: Dominguez, Piron, Warnick and Lorenzo Tio
summary: He played with Dominguez and Piron, with Louie Warnick on New York company jobs, and Tio in the Tuxedo band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Fiddlers and reading violinists of New Orleans

blocks.x: Was that the only violin player you ever played with, Paul Dominguez? Any violin player?
I played with Des Dominguez. Yeah. I played with Des Dominguez. Oh, yeah.

Yeah, I played with Des Dominguez. You ever played with P-Roll? Yeah. Oh, yeah. I played with P-Roll all the time. I used to play—I used to play in—how'd they call this place? Tell your tail? I said, no. Tell that fellow. One used to play saxophone when they died. Louie Warnick. Louie Warnick. Louie Warnick. I used to play Louie Warnick. Louie Warnick used to work for Eugene Deeson and he used to go to New York with his company all the time. And I used to work one and two months at a time.
There was the Blueprint. The Blueprint company? The Blueprint company?
Yeah. Eugene Deeson. I was in that one day. Yeah. You ever played alongside Lorenzo Teo, I guess? Lorenzo Teo?

Yeah. You played with him? Teo used to play with Tuxedo Band when I used to play with Tuxedo Band. Yeah, you played together. With originally Celestan. That's years ago. That's years ago. Then they started the band. How do you like playing the clarinet with the violin in the band? Who?
